statement: For zero-mean jointly Gaussian Y_i with each variance at most epsilon^2 and total marginal variance at most one, E max(0,max_i Y_i)=O(epsilon sqrt(log(1/epsilon))).
interpretation: Standard asymptotic big-O as epsilon tends to zero.
verdict_rule: VERIFIED by an explicit universal upper bound for epsilon<=exp(-1), plus a nonzero family saturating both variance constraints and independently checked quadrature.
